job.title: Life Claims - Senior Case Managers / Case Managers
job.description:
Our client is a global life insurance business, which has a long-standing presence and strong reputation in the Australian market. The business already has a large and established claims function (and support functions) and these new roles are designed to support the business, existing team and future growth.

Roles and Information:






  • Case Manager and Senior Case Managers
  • Group and Retail Teams
  • Salary range of $105K - $135K Package + Bonus
  • Hybrid working arrangements (2 or 3 days working from home)
  • Strong team culture and onboarding
  • Newly created roles across corporate & industry funds to choose from
  • Employee incentive plan and discounted insurance


Responsibilties/ Tasks:







  • Manage a portfolio of retail or group claims
  • Senior Case Managers manage a smaller portfolio of more complex and detailed claims
  • Work with empathy and understanding with claimants
  • Conduct file reviews on assessed claims for payment approvals
  • For Seniors, coach and mentor more junior claims consultants


If you have ife insurance claims experience (or potentially WC or Rehab) and want a change and to work for a growing business, then there are multiple roles. You will join teams with experienced and capable managers, and have the full support of a well-planned training and onboarding function. It's a time many are joining so you will be far from the only new starter.

If you are interested in new opportunities in life claims, please reach out to John Molony (john@bkcon.com.au).

job.title: Distribution Associate - Funds Manager
job.description:
Our client is a growing investment fund in the alternatives space. The Distribution Associate will provide the logistical, administrative and coordination support that will enable the institutional distribution team to operate effectively.

Working with senior distribution colleagues and the Institutional Sales Manager, the role manages travel arrangements, meeting schedules, CRM administration and preparation of meeting materials. It will suit an organised individual with strong attention to detail who wants to develop a career in funds management and distribution.

Key Responsibilities

Roadshow Logistics and Travel

  • Organise domestic and international travel, accommodation, transfers, venues and meeting arrangements for roadshows and investment manager visits.
  • Maintain detailed itineraries, distribute joining instructions and promptly communicate changes to participants.
  • Coordinate bookings, expenses and logistical requirements within agreed budgets and approval processes.

Meeting and Calendar Coordination

  • Coordinate institutional investor, consultant and investment manager meeting schedules, including invitations, confirmations and calendar management.
  • Arrange calls and video conferences across time zones, resolve scheduling conflicts and keep attendees informed.
  • Collate agendas, briefing packs and presentation materials, ensuring the correct versions are available ahead of meetings.

CRM Administration and Data Quality

  • Enter and maintain accurate contact details, meeting records, opportunities and next steps in the CRM using input from the distribution team.
  • Maintain investor and consultant lists, correct incomplete or duplicate records and support consistent CRM use.
  • Produce routine activity and pipeline reports from agreed templates and flag missing information or overdue actions.

Sales Administration and Materials Support

  • Format and update pitch decks, manager profiles and meeting packs using approved content and templates.
  • Request and collate investment manager information, maintain document libraries and track versions and approval status.
  • Provide administrative support for proposals and due diligence questionnaires, including document assembly, formatting and submission tracking.
  • Conduct basic investor and consultant research and maintain prospect lists under the direction of senior colleagues.

Workflow and Project Coordination

  • Maintain action lists, project schedules and deadlines for roadshows, manager visits, fund launches and other distribution activities.
  • Track incoming requests, allocate them to the appropriate colleague and follow up on outstanding inputs.
  • Liaise with marketing, operations and investment teams on practical requirements and escalate delays or conflicting priorities.
  • Identify improvements to scheduling, record keeping and routine sales administration.

Experience and Capabilities

  • Experience in administration, team coordination, sales support or a related role; financial services experience is desirable, including funds management.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to coordinate multiple calendars, deadlines and travel arrangements.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and a professional approach to internal and external contacts.
  • Proficiency in Outlook, PowerPoint and Excel, with experience using CRM systems or the ability to learn quickly.
  • A proactive, reliable and collaborative approach, including discretion with confidential information.
  • An interest in investment markets and institutional funds management; relevant tertiary qualifications are desirable.

Measures of Success

  • Accurate, well-organised travel arrangements, schedules and meeting packs.
  • Complete and current CRM records and reliable routine reporting.
  • Timely coordination of requests and actions, helping the distribution team meet its commitments.

This is a great role to get exposure to a fund which is growing, working with an experienced sales leadership team. You will need to be naturally energetic and solutions focused and be able to work in a fast moving environment. As you can see from the job description, it's a very varied role and not just sales focused.

If this is a role that sounds of interest, please apply or contact John Molony (john@bkcon.com.au).
